author: Associated Press Television News
title: Australia's Beach Boxes: Unique Real Estate with Limited Comforts
text:
• Australia's beach boxes are located in and around Melbourne.
• These structures lack basic features such as electricity, plumbing, and bedrooms.
• Beach boxes are used for storing beach-related items like toys, kayaks, and BBQs.
• Some beach boxes can sell for more than the average suburban house in Melbourne.
• Beach boxes are built on public land and cannot be rented out or used for commercial purposes.
• A buyer must own a home in the area to purchase a beach box.
• Solar cells and motorized electricity generators are prohibited.
• The beach boxes have been part of Victoria's coastline since the 19th century.
• The most expensive beach boxes can be found in Portsea, selling for up to AU$1.2 million.
• A record sale for a beach box outside Portsea occurred at Mount Martha for AU$1 million.
• The mean price of a Melbourne dwelling was AU$803,194 in August 2025.
• Real estate agents suggest that beach boxes can double in value every 7 to 10 years.
• Owners of beach boxes must pay annual license fees and public liability insurance.
• The structures were originally created to preserve modesty during the Victorian era.
